objects.H: Real Hilbert completion of the R-510 gauge-invariant local cylinder state modulo zero L2 norm. Complexification, if used for a source theorem, changes neither real form nor model.

Use only the original directed 1/2 convention. No total global exit-rate finiteness or new global rate envelope is assumed.
objects.minimal_closure: Complete D in ||f||_E1^2=||f||_H^2+E(f,f), prove its natural map into H is injective, and transport E to its image. Prove this is the smallest domain closed extension agreeing with E on D, not a maximal jump-domain identification.
objects.radial_space: D_rad={f in D: f depends only on finitely many amplitudes}; H_rad is its H-norm closure. Do not replace H_rad by only selected witnesses. The target is H_rad subset Dom(Ebar) and Ebar(h,h)=0 for ALL h in H_rad. If identified with measurable amplitude-only L2 functions, supply the density argument.
objects.kernel_boundary: Do not claim ker(Ebar)=H_rad or absence of nonradial tail zero modes. Retention of the radial subspace does not classify the entire kernel.
